name: fmp_upgrades_downgrades
description:
Analyst rating changes for one stock from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/upgrades-downgrades): firm, action, previous and new grade, date.
Returns {symbol, changes}: FMP's list of rating-change records.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, e.g. AAPL; upper-cased), limit (integer, number of records; default 5).
For the consensus rating use fmp_upgrades_downgrades_consensus; for price targets fmp_price_target.
Example: {"symbol": "MSFT", "limit": 5}
